description: React Native component for a review modal allowing users to rate and review an order, including star rating, order details display, and submission via GraphQL mutation.

classes.name: StarRating
classes.description: Component for selecting star rating, displays star icons and handles user interaction.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Callback for successful review submission, resets description and closes modal.

methods.name: fetchOrder
methods.description: Fetches order details from GraphQL server based on orderId.

methods.name: onSelectRating
methods.description: Handles user selecting a star rating, shows review section.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Submits the review via GraphQL mutation.

methods.name: onPress
methods.description: Handles star icon press, updates selected rating.
